spec:
1. Add a habits route group in backend/src/routes/ registered in create-api-app.ts.
2. Implement POST /api/v1/habits to create a habit (name required, cadence defaults to daily).
3. Implement GET /api/v1/habits to list non-archived habits.
4. Implement GET /api/v1/habits/:id to fetch a single habit.
5. Implement PATCH /api/v1/habits/:id to update name, notes, and target.
6. Implement POST /api/v1/habits/:id/archive to set archivedAt.
7. Return typed JSON responses with proper status codes (201 on create, 404 on missing).
8. Extract any handler over 30 lines into a named function in the route file.
9. Confirm updatedAt changes on every mutation.
10. Verify archived habits are excluded from the default list.
11. Run `bun run smoke:qc` and confirm it passes.
title: Habit CRUD REST API
